note: Real responses. Values never altered. Trimmed files were re-serialised as compact JSON after cutting arrays; untrimmed files are byte-for-byte as received.

fees_recommended.json.notes: Object of integers: `fastestFee, halfHourFee, hourFee, economyFee, minimumFee` (sat/vB).

fees_precise.json.notes: Same keys, floats to 3 decimals. `minimumFee` was 0.1, so sub-1 sat/vB rates are live.

fees_mempool_blocks.json.notes: Array of 8 projected blocks: `blockSize, blockVSize, nTx, totalFees, medianFee, feeRange[7]`.

prices.json.notes: `time` plus USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, CHF, AUD, JPY as integers.

difficulty_adjustment.json.notes: `progressPercent, difficultyChange, estimatedRetargetDate` (ms), `remainingBlocks, remainingTime` (ms), `previousRetarget, previousTime` (s), `nextRetargetHeight, timeAvg` (ms), `adjustedTimeAvg, timeOffset, expectedBlocks`.

block.json.notes: `/api/v1/block/{hash}`: Esplora block fields plus `stale` and `extras{reward, coinbaseRaw, coinbaseSignatureAscii, medianFee, feeRange[7], totalFees, avgFee, avgFeeRate, feePercentiles, virtualSize, totalInputs, totalOutputs, utxoSetChange, utxoSetSize, pool{id,name,slug,minerNames}, matchRate, expectedFees, expectedWeight, similarity, firstSeen, ...}`. `matchRate` is the audit health.

mining_blocks_audit_scores.json.notes: EXISTS. Array of 16 `{hash, matchRate, expectedFees, expectedWeight}` for the latest blocks. `/audit/scores/{height}` also answered 200 with the same shape.

mining_blocks_audit_score.json.notes: EXISTS. `/api/v1/mining/blocks/audit/score/{hash}`, one object of the same shape.

tx_opreturn.json.notes: Confirmed tx with an OP_RETURN output (`scriptpubkey_type: "op_return"`, payload decodes as ASCII). Has `sigops`.

tx_outspends.json.notes: Array per output: `{spent, txid, vin, status{...}}`, or `{spent:false}`.

cpfp.json.notes: Confirmed tx with no package: just `{"ancestors":[]}`.

cpfp_mempool.json.notes: Mempool tx: `ancestors[{txid,fee,weight}], bestDescendant, descendants[], effectiveFeePerVsize, sigops, fee, adjustedVsize, cluster{txs[{txid,fee,weight,parents[]}], chunks[{txs[],feerate}], chunkIndex}`.

tx_rbf.json.notes: `{replacements: <tree>, replaces: [txid,...]}`. A tree node is `{tx{txid,fee,vsize,value,rate,time,rbf,fullRbf?}, time, fullRbf, interval?, replaces:[<tree>...]}`.

tx_rbf_confirmed_none.json.notes: A tx with no RBF history: `{"replacements":null,"replaces":null}`.

transaction_times.json.notes: Two confirmed txids return `[0,0]`. First-seen time is only known for transactions the node saw recently.

transaction_times_mempool.json.notes: A mempool txid returns `[1789844053]` (unix seconds). Query is `?txId[]=a&txId[]=b`.

address.json.notes: `address, chain_stats{funded_txo_count, funded_txo_sum, spent_txo_count, spent_txo_sum, tx_count}, mempool_stats{...}`. Balance is funded minus spent.

mining_pools_1w.json.notes: `pools[{poolId, name, link, blockCount, rank, emptyBlocks, slug, avgMatchRate, avgFeeDelta, poolUniqueId}], blockCount, lastEstimatedHashrate, lastEstimatedHashrate3d, lastEstimatedHashrate1w`. No share field: compute `blockCount / total`.

mining_pool_foundryusa.json.notes: `pool{id,name,link,addresses[],regexes[],slug,unique_id}, blockCount{all,24h,1w}, blockShare{all,24h,1w}, estimatedHashrate, reportedHashrate, avgBlockHealth, totalReward`.

mining_hashrate_3m.json.notes: `hashrates[{timestamp, avgHashrate}]` (daily, H/s), `difficulty[{time, height, difficulty, adjustment}], currentHashrate, currentDifficulty`.

mining_difficulty_adjustments_1y.json.notes: Array of arrays `[time, height, difficulty, changeRatio]`. The last value is a ratio (1.04163 is +4.163%).

mining_reward_stats_144.json.notes: `startBlock, endBlock, totalReward, totalFee, totalTx`. The three totals are strings.

lightning_statistics_latest.json.notes: `latest{id, added, channel_count, node_count, total_capacity, tor_nodes, clearnet_nodes, unannounced_nodes, avg_capacity, avg_fee_rate, avg_base_fee_mtokens, med_capacity, med_fee_rate, med_base_fee_mtokens, clearnet_tor_nodes}`. STALE: `added` was 2026-08-30, 20 days before the request.

lightning_statistics_3m.json.notes: Array, newest first, of `{added (unix), channel_count, total_capacity, tor_nodes, clearnet_nodes, unannounced_nodes, clearnet_tor_nodes}`. Newest point is also 2026-08-30.

lightning_nodes_rankings.json.notes: `topByCapacity[{publicKey, alias, capacity}], topByChannels[{publicKey, alias, channels, city, country, iso_code, subdivision}]`.

lightning_nodes_country_bare_500.json.notes: `/api/v1/lightning/nodes/country` with no code returns HTTP 500 `{"error":"Failed to get node"}`. The list is at `/nodes/countries`.

backend_info.json.notes: `hostname, version (3.4-dev), gitCommit, lightning, backend (esplora), coreVersion, osVersion`.

address_utxo_too_many_400.txt.notes: HTTP 400, plain text: `Too many unspent transaction outputs (>500). Contact support to raise limits.` Seen for the genesis address. ADDR must handle it.

blocks.json.notes: `/api/v1/blocks` returns 15 blocks, newest first, same shape as one block.

block_txs_0.json.notes: 25 full Esplora transactions per page; `start` must be a multiple of 25.

block_audit_summary.json.trimmed: template trimmed to 5 of 3844; every txid list trimmed to 3
block_audit_summary.json.notes: EXISTS. `version, templateAlgorithm, height, id, timestamp, template[{txid,fee,vsize,value,rate,time,flags}], unseenTxs[], missingTxs[], addedTxs[], prioritizedTxs[], freshTxs[], sigopTxs[], fullrbfTxs[], acceleratedTxs[], matchRate, expectedFees, expectedWeight`. 721 KB untrimmed.

replacements.json.notes: Array of 25 replacement trees, same node shape as `tx_rbf.json`.

fullrbf_replacements.json.notes: Same shape, only trees with `fullRbf: true`.

address_txs.json.trimmed: first 3 txs under 3.5 KB of the 50 returned (page was 4.5 MB)
address_txs.json.notes: This page held 50 confirmed transactions, newest first. Page on with `/txs/chain/{last_txid}`. The untrimmed page was 4.5 MB because of two very large transactions.

mining_pool_foundryusa_hashrate.json.notes: Array of `{timestamp, avgHashrate, share, poolName}`, weekly points.

mining_blocks_fee_rates_1w.json.notes: Array of `{avgHeight, timestamp, avgFee_0, avgFee_10, avgFee_25, avgFee_50, avgFee_75, avgFee_90, avgFee_100}`. Integers, so sub-1 sat/vB shows as 0.

mining_blocks_rewards_1w.json.notes: EXISTS. Array of `{avgHeight, timestamp, avgRewards, USD}` (sats, and the USD price).

mining_blocks_fees_1w.json.notes: EXISTS. Array of `{avgHeight, timestamp, avgFees, USD}`.

lightning_nodes_countries.json.notes: The country list: `[{name{en,de,...}, iso, count, share, capacity}]`. `capacity` is a string.

lightning_nodes_country_us.json.notes: `/api/v1/lightning/nodes/country/{iso}`: `country{...}, nodes[{public_key, capacity, channels, alias, first_seen, updated_at, city, country, iso_code, subdivision, longitude, latitude, as_number, isp}]`. 3 MB untrimmed.

lightning_nodes_isp_ranking.json.notes: `clearnetCapacity, torCapacity, unknownCapacity, ispRanking[[asn_csv, name, capacity, channels, nodes], ...]`.

ws_init.json.trimmed: reply to {action:init}; blocks trimmed to 2 of 8, transactions and rbfSummary to 3 of 6; mempool-blocks complete
ws_init.json.notes: Keys: `mempoolInfo, vBytesPerSecond, mempool-blocks, transactions, loadingIndicators, fees, rbfSummary, conversions, backend, blocks, backendInfo, da`.

ws_want_reply.json.trimmed: reply to {action:want,data:[blocks,mempool-blocks,stats]}; blocks trimmed to 2 of 8
ws_want_reply.json.notes: Keys: `blocks, mempool-blocks, mempoolInfo, vBytesPerSecond, fees, da`.

ws_stats_update.json.trimmed: a periodic (about 1 per second) update; transactions trimmed to 3
ws_stats_update.json.notes: Keys: `mempoolInfo, vBytesPerSecond, transactions, da, fees, mempool-blocks`. Arrives about once per second.

ws_projected_block_full.json.trimmed: reply to {track-mempool-block:0}; blockTransactions trimmed to first 6 of 4355
ws_projected_block_full.json.notes: `{"projected-block-transactions": {index, sequence, blockTransactions: [[txid, fee, vsize, value, rate, flags, time], ...]}}`. 508 KB untrimmed.

ws_projected_block_delta.json.trimmed: a periodic update carrying a delta; added/removed/changed trimmed to 3 each; transactions to 2
ws_projected_block_delta.json.notes: The periodic update with `projected-block-transactions: {index, sequence, delta{added[[7 fields]], removed[txid], changed[[txid, rate, flags, acc]]}}` added to it.

ws_rbf_latest.json.trimmed: reply to {track-rbf:all}; trimmed to 2 replacement trees
ws_rbf_latest.json.notes: `{"rbfLatest": [<tree>, ...]}`, same tree shape as `/api/v1/replacements`. About 75 KB each untrimmed.

ws_block.json.notes: A new block (967,732). Keys: `block, mempoolInfo, vBytesPerSecond, fees, da, mempool-blocks, projected-block-transactions`. `block` (singular) is one block in the `/api/v1/blocks` shape with full `extras`. The same message resets the tracked projected block with a full `blockTransactions` list, not a delta. 511 KB untrimmed.

ws_accelerations.json.notes: Arrived unrequested, one second before the block. Safe to ignore.
